Synopsis:
US equities closed marginally lower on Aug 26 as a hotter-than-expected inflation print (PCE +3.7% YoY for July) added uncertainty to the Fed's policy path, while markets awaited Nvidia's earnings. Fed Chair Warsh's Jackson Hole speech on Friday is the next key catalyst. Rate hike odds for September stand at 38.1%. Mixed sector performance: healthcare lagged, mega-caps Meta and Apple gained. Earnings beats/misses drove individual stock moves (Intuit lower, Smucker higher). Breadth was negative on both NYSE and Nasdaq, on below-average volume.
